jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.
The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.
OPERATING PRINCIPLES
Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:
 1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
 2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
 3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
 4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.
We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.
AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT
We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.
That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:
 - Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
 - Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
 - Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
 - Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.
We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.
About the Role
We are building the next generation of People Operations at Deepgram. We're looking for a technically strong, AI-native builder to partner directly with our Director of People Operations to identify, design, build, and maintain AI-first workflows that fundamentally change how People and Talent operate, and then share what works with other teams across Deepgram.
This isn't a traditional systems or Operations admin role. You'll own the systems that sit on top of and between our People tools: connecting and configuring them through APIs, webhooks, and workflows, and turning manual, repetitive, high-friction People processes into intelligent workflows using AI, automation, internal tools, and agents. Just as importantly, you'll debug, maintain, and scale what you build so it keeps working as Deepgram grows.
You'll sit within People Operations and partner with Talent, IT, Security, Finance and other key functions to build secure, scalable solutions that allow team members and managers to get answers and complete workflows without requiring a People team member for every interaction.
This is a highly hands-on role for someone who loves building, experimenting, and turning operational chaos into order. You might be an early-career engineer, a career resetter, or a People Ops or talent operations professional who taught yourself to code and automate. What matters is what you can build, and that you want to build it for People.
What You'll Do
 - Partner directly with the People Operations and Talent teams to identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across systems.
 - Turn manual People workflows into automated, AI-powered systems.
 - Build AI agents and workflows that can answer questions, gather information, initiate processes, and complete defined actions.
 - Integrate AI systems with existing tools, including Ashby, Slack, Metaview, BambooHR, Lattice, Pave, Carta, and other internal systems.
 - Configure and connect our People tools beyond AI, including Ashby workflows, webhooks, APIs, and vendor integrations, so the team can move faster without relying on vendor support and walkthroughs.
 - Integrate AI systems with existing processes, including recruiting, onboarding, performance, and compensation.
 - Build an AI-first virtual onboarding experience that is scalable, and provides an exceptional team member experience.
 - Build internal tools and interfaces that make People processes dramatically easier for employees, managers, and the People team.
 - Prototype quickly, test with real users, learn from what works, and iterate.
 - Establish appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, escalation paths, permissions, and safeguards for sensitive People workflows.
 - Partner with Engineering and IT on architecture, security, access controls, and productionizing successful prototypes.
 - Measure whether what you build actually saves time, improves the employee experience, or increases the quality and consistency of People Operations.
 - Build people analytics and dashboards (e.g., ARR per employee, manager-facing performance insights) and share information responsibly, protecting sensitive employee data.
 - Debug, maintain, and scale the systems you build, document them so others can maintain them, and share proven approaches with other teams across Deepgram.
 - Handle sensitive employee information and unreleased work with sound professional discretion.
Experience
 - 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, automation, internal tools, technical People or talent operations, or a similar role. Self-taught, hands-on experience building and shipping real tools counts just as much.
 - Working proficiency in Python and SQL (TypeScript/JavaScript or Apps Script a plus), and comfort working with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.
 - Familiarity with People systems such as BambooHR, OysterHR, SequoiaOne, Ashby, Metaview, Lattice, Pave, Carta, and Ethena is a plus; you can learn the specific tools on the job.

Remote role based in Athens, covering mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens). Independent contractor engagement at $3,500–$4,500 per month (USD), depending on experience. As a contractor, you’ll invoice us monthly and handle your own taxes and social security contributions.
ABOUT 3Y HEALTH
3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. We're backed by over $200mm from Founders Fund, General Catalyst, SoftBank and 8VC.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We enter new markets by acquiring a foundational clinic for each specialty and region we go into, and we partner with independent clinics across the country. Every clinic adds entities, filings, contracts, staff records and deadlines that need to stay in order.
In this role, you'll own a set of our entities from start to finish. When we acquire a clinic, you'll carry out its integration plan: collect and file the records, prepare the filings, get staff ready for day one and follow up with everyone until each item is closed. Each deal comes with a detailed plan and timeline from the deal lead. Acquired clinics keep running largely as they do today until we bring them onto our platform, usually within a few months. Once a clinic is integrated, you'll keep its entity in good standing, alongside the existing entities you own.
You don't need experience in US healthcare. Every deal comes with a detailed checklist, and we'll teach you the US specifics. You need to learn fast, care about details and follow through. You'll work closely with our Corporate Development, Legal, Billing and HR teams in the US, and with a teammate in the same role.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Acquisitions
 - Work through each deal's integration checklist from before signing through the first months after close, keep the tracker current, and flag anything at risk of slipping
 - Document how the clinic runs today, such as scheduling, intake, referrals and billing handoffs
 - Check that each acquired entity is in good standing, and that its legal name and tax ID match across IRS, state, bank and payer records
 - Support our team and advisors on payer change-of-ownership notices, Medicare enrollment updates and credentialing checks
 - Map every payer's electronic payment setup (EFT/ERA) and each clinic's bank accounts, so our billing team can keep cash flowing through close
 - Prepare staff for day one: verify the employee roster, gather employment records for legal review, run license and exclusion checks, collect onboarding paperwork securely, and help get payroll, benefits and staff FAQs ready
 - Inventory each clinic's vendors, software and logins, collect business associate agreements (BAAs) for legal review, and track which systems switch to ours at close, later or not at all
 - Follow through after close on staff communication, moving patients of departing providers to remaining clinicians, lease and facility license items, and the former owners' transition commitments
Entity management and corporate operations
 - Keep the entities you own in good standing, primarily by managing our vendors: prepare annual reports, state registrations, IRS updates and other filings, and track them to on-time filing with our legal team
 - Maintain entity records, including formation documents, officers, registered agents and ownership
 - Prepare and submit provider and facility enrollments with state Medicaid programs and other public payers, and track them to approval
 - Make sure incoming mail for your entities is logged, routed and acted on, especially anything with a deadline
 - Prepare contracts from templates, route them for signature, and keep our contract management system and renewal dates current
 - Note what worked and what didn't, so our checklists get better with each deal
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 - 2–5 years in healthcare operations, practice management, credentialing or provider enrollment, or acquisition integration
 - A track record of managing many details and deadlines to completion
 - Comfort working with contracts, licenses and government forms. You read carefully and catch errors.
 - Strong spreadsheet skills, and quick to learn new systems
 - Excellent written and spoken English. Most of your work is with US teams, agencies and vendors, and most decisions happen in writing.
 - Comfort handling confidential information
 - High agency and low ego. You don't need to be chased, and you'll do the tedious work as carefully as the interesting work.
 - Based in Athens and able to work mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens)
NICE TO HAVE
 - Experience in US healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry
 - Experience working with US companies or customers
 - Experience with corporate filings, contract administration or compliance work
 - Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to work faster
WHAT WE OFFER
 - A monthly fee of $3,500–$4,500 (USD), depending on experience
 - A long-term role at a venture-backed US company, working closely with leadership
 - Room to grow as we acquire more clinics and enter new specialties
ENGAGEMENT
This is a long-term independent contractor engagement with 3Y Health, not an employment contract. You'll need to be registered as a freelancer in Greece, or be willing to register before your start date. You'll be paid monthly in USD.
If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.
